## Professional Summary

Independent AI Architect and Senior Full Stack Architect with 9+ years building scalable AI & SaaS solutions, working since January 2017. Founder of Apex36. Helped build the infrastructure and GenAI platform behind DecoverAI, now used in large US law firms, which raised $2M+ in seed funding. Led a COE of 10+ engineers at LTI Mindtree. 12+ AI and SaaS products shipped across 7 industries.

End-to-end ownership across architecture → development → deployment → scaling, collaborating closely with clients and engineering teams worldwide.

## Services

1. **Full Stack Architecture** - React, Angular, Next.js, Node.js, .NET Core, Python, TypeScript
2. **AI/ML Engineering** - RAG, Vector DBs, Text2SQL, Semantic Search, AI Agents, Prompt Engineering, voice AI
3. **SaaS Product Development** - Multi-tenancy, scalable APIs, microservices, event-driven architecture
4. **DevOps & Cloud** - AWS, Azure, GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines

## Apex36 Products

- **BrandGen** (live, getbrandgen.com) - Brand-aligned AI image generator on Next.js, Gemini and PostgreSQL.
- **TriageGrid** (GA, triagegrid.com) - AI email triage for US and UK law firms on Microsoft 365.
- **Convo AI** (live, heyyconvo.com) - AI voice receptionist for hotels, restaurants, clinics, real estate and finance. Vapi, Deepgram, GPT-4o-mini.
- **CC Logins** (open source, MIT, github.com/yashsoni369/cc-logins) - Rust and Tauri tray app showing Claude Code quota across subscriptions and switching accounts. Adapted from MIT-licensed code by Onur Cetinkol.
- **AI Tutor** (proof of concept) - AI speaking tutor for schools with a video avatar.

## Key Client Projects

### DecoverAI - AI Legal Document Platform (US)
Legal document management and query platform for US law firms. Yash helped build the infrastructure and GenAI platform, about 13 months of work, as the company raised $2M+ in seed funding from Bay Area VCs.

### Speakology AI - AI Language Learning (UK)
AI Avatar language learning app for UK schools. Bootstrapped from zero to 10+ school subscriptions in 3 months.
- Tech: Node.js, React, MongoDB, OpenAI, Prompt Engineering

### United Medical - Healthcare Contract Management (Germany)
Hospital-doctor contract management application for a German healthcare startup. Active retainer since August 2023.
- Tech: Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Redis

### Mappie AI - AI Project Management
Built for Nindo Solutions (Belgium). Turns messy requirements into dev-ready user stories. 60-70% reduction in backlog grooming time (Apex36 case-study data); beta expanded to 1,000 users.
- Tech: React, TypeScript, OpenAI, Node.js

### Vectro AI - Sales Intelligence
Actionable insights from sales calls, emails & Slack communications using AI and vector search.
- Tech: Node.js, OpenAI, Vector DB, TypeScript

### Water Advisor AI (US, March 2026 - present)
Consumer water-quality advisor: address, local water report lookup, LLM-parsed structured advice.
- Tech: Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, LLM parsing

### Stethy - AI Email Triage SaaS (contract from July 2024)
Invite-only B2B email triage platform. Backend and infrastructure work: Python and TypeScript, AWS CDK multi-account pipelines, Langfuse observability.

### LTI Mindtree products
- **Infinity DevOps** - DevOps platform across AWS and GCP. Angular, React, Node.js, MongoDB, Docker, Kubernetes, Kafka.
- **Infinity AIWatch** - APM product with AI-driven dashboards. React, Python, OpenAI, PostgreSQL, InfluxDB, Prometheus.
